note: distll.pub is a now 'on hiatus' on-line publication that had many beautiful articles mostly on NN and AI (circa 2016-2021). Their content and source are all published under a libre/free license. Their post on why they went on Hiatus is interesting, talking about how there are competing goals and that self publishing better serves the research and expository goals. One choice quote: 'But for every paper [that can benefit from peer review] there are thousands of papers whose audience is a handful of the same researchers we ask to perform review.'
